ei.title: Branding Academic Writing: Developing Your Own Unique Voice Imprinting on Your Readers

fullPassage: Gaining an audience for your writing involves not just finding a voice but ensuring that voice resonates with your intended readers. Entrepreneurs understand the importance of building a brand that makes them memorable and distinct from their competitors, drawing customers to their products or services. They achieve this by pinpointing their target audience, crafting a unique value proposition, and shaping a recognizable identity. While scholars might initially find these entrepreneurial concepts alien, they actually engage in similar practices when they set themselves apart in their academic writing. Consider the typical literature review and motivation section of a scholarly article ― the aim is to highlight gaps in existing research and position oneself as the one who will address these overlooked areas. The challenge, as Labaree suggests, is not just in developing innovative ideas but in cultivating a distinctive voice that makes readers think, "Ah, this sounds like [the author]." It's about balancing the expression of your ideas with the development of a unique voice that leaves a lasting impression on your audience.

Entrepreneurs understand the importance of building a brand that makes them (B)[memorable / forgettable] and distinct from their competitors, drawing customers to their products or services. They achieve this by pinpointing their target audience, crafting a unique value proposition, and shaping a recognizable identity. While scholars might initially find these entrepreneurial concepts alien, they actually engage in similar practices when they set themselves apart in their academic writing. Consider the typical literature review and motivation section of a scholarly article ― the aim is to highlight gaps in existing research and position oneself as the one who will address these overlooked areas. The challenge, as Labaree suggests, is not just in developing innovative ideas but in cultivating a (C)[distinctive / ordinary] voice that makes readers think, "Ah, this sounds like [the author]." It's about balancing the expression of your ideas with the development of a unique voice that leaves a lasting impression on your audience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① resonates - memorable - distinctive: 독자와 '공감하는' 목소리, '기억에 남는' 브랜드, '독특한' 목소리라는 본문 내용.
❌ ② clashes - memorable - distinctive: '충돌한다'는 의도된 독자에게 다가가려는 목적과 모순.
❌ ③ resonates - forgettable - distinctive: '잊히기 쉬운' 브랜드는 기업가가 원하는 바의 정반대.
❌ ④ resonates - memorable - ordinary: '평범한' 목소리는 set themselves apart(차별화)와 모순.
det.tip: resonate(공감하다) ↔ clash(충돌하다). memorable(기억에 남는) ↔ forgettable(잊히는). distinctive(독특한) ↔ ordinary(평범한)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ distinct - unique - gaps: 경쟁자와 '구별되는' 브랜드, '독특한' 가치 제안, 기존 연구의 '공백'이라는 본문 내용.
❌ ① identical - unique - gaps: '동일한'은 경쟁자와 차별화된다는 맥락과 모순.

det.tip: distinct(구별되는) ↔ identical(동일한). unique(독특한) ↔ common(흔한). gap(공백, 간극) ↔ conclusion(결론)

det.analysis:
✅ ④ pinpointing - alien - leaves: 타깃 독자를 '정확히 파악'하고, 학자에게는 처음엔 '낯선' 개념이며, 지속적인 인상을 '남기는' 목소리라는 본문 내용.
❌ ① neglecting - alien - leaves: '무시한다'는 타깃을 찾는 전략과 정반대.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① resonates: 의도된 독자와 '공감을 일으킨다'는 원문 그대로.
❌ ② alien: 학자에게 처음엔 '낯선' 개념이라는 원문 그대로.
❌ ③ overlooked: '간과된' 영역이라는 원문 그대로.
✅ ④ generic: 원문은 distinctive(독특한). '일반적인' 목소리는 'sounds like [the author]'(저자다움)와 정반대.
det.tip: distinctive(독특한) ↔ generic(일반적인, 평범한). 저자의 고유한 목소리를 강조하는 맥락.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① concealing: 원문은 ensuring(보장하는 것). 목소리가 독자와 공감하도록 '숨기는 것'은 독자 확보 목표와 정반대.
❌ ② memorable: '기억에 남는' 브랜드 — 원문 그대로.
❌ ③ unique: '독특한' 가치 제안 — 원문 그대로.
❌ ④ innovative: '혁신적인' 아이디어 — 원문 그대로.
det.tip: ensure(보장하다) ↔ conceal(숨기다). 독자 확보를 위해 목소리가 독자에게 가닿도록 '보장'하는 것이 핵심.

❌ ① drawing: 고객을 '끌어들인다'는 원문 그대로.

❌ ④ lasting: '지속적인' 인상이라는 원문 그대로.

det.tip: set ~ apart = 차별화하다, 구별하다. 기업의 brand differentiation에 해당하는 학자의 행동.

det.analysis:

❌ ③ (A) 형성하다 - (B) 형성하다: (B)는 추상적 형성이 아닌 실제 손으로 모양을 만드는 행위.
❌ ④ (A) 모양을 빚다 - (B) 모양을 빚다: (A)에서 정체성을 물리적으로 빚는다는 것은 적절하지 않음.
